title: AdoptionAnchor
description: Adoption provenance recorded on a destination KnowledgeEntry (spoke-knowledge-adoption). Points at the resolved terminal live source — retirement chains resolve before the anchor is written. Carried on the optional adoption_anchor field of KnowledgeEntry; a normal put must preserve it unchanged.

source_scope_id.description: Scope id of the resolved terminal source.

source_entry_id.description: Entry id of the resolved terminal source.

source_revision.description: Revision of the resolved terminal source.
